title: Understanding 4-way Replication
text: In a 4-way replication system, each fragment of the file is stored on $$4$$ different machines. This means that even if some machines fail, the file can still be reconstructed as long as at least one copy of each fragment is available.

title: Calculating Machine Failures
text: To determine the maximum number of machines that can fail, consider how many machines are storing each fragment. Since each fragment is stored on $$4$$ machines, think about how many machines can fail while still having at least one copy of each fragment available.
